secret.description: The key to present as a bearer credential. Shown once, in this response only; the service keeps its hash and cannot show it again.

get.summary: The database is reachable and every shipped migration is applied with a matching checksum.

post.summary: Hold an explicit assignment for a time range. Returns a receipt, never a token. Refused with 422 outside_schedule when the venue has service periods and the range is not inside one.

201.description: Held, or the stored success replayed

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

get.summary: List the live holds the calling key owns in a venue, soonest expiry first. For a key scoped to all venues a venue that does not exist lists nothing; a venue outside the key's venues answers 404.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Bookable start times for a party in a window, each with the exact starts_at, duration_minutes, and assignment a hold accepts. Read from live occupancy; a hold is still the judge. The window may not exceed the venue's availability window (422 window_too_large); a venue outside the key's venues answers 404.

200.description: The bookable slots in start order, and whether the list was cut short

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

get.summary: Read a reservation with its effective status and history.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Cancel a held, confirmed, or seated reservation.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues
Not found or outside the key's venues
Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Mint a single-use confirm token for a human channel. Replaces any previous token. The only response that carries a token.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Confirm a held reservation with a key that has the confirm capability, or with a confirm token and no key. expected_version applies to the key path only.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

get.summary: List the venue's units, inactive ones included, in label order. Requires the admin capability; a venue outside the key's venues answers 404.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Create a unit with a capacity range and an optional layout. capacity_max below capacity_min is 400 validation; a range the database refuses is 422 invalid_input.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

patch.summary: Change a unit's label, capacity range, layout, or activity; a field left out keeps its value. A narrower capacity range strands the live reservations assigned directly to the unit whose party falls outside it, and a deactivation strands every live reservation using the unit, including those of combinations that contain it. A write that would strand live reservations answers 409 (capacity_conflict, assignment_in_use) with their ids in `stranded` and writes nothing. With force the reservations are cancelled in the same transaction, with cancel_reason (default "venue change") and an outbox event each, and returned in `cancelled`; force answers 409 reservation_in_progress when one has started and 422 force_too_large above 200. A unit of another venue answers 404.

200.description: The unit and the ids of the reservations cancelled by force

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

get.summary: List the venue's combinations, inactive ones included, in label order. Requires the admin capability; a venue outside the key's venues answers 404.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Create a combination of 2 to 6 distinct units of the venue with a capacity range of its own. Members that repeat, do not exist, or belong to another venue are 422 assignment_mismatch. Members and capacities cannot be changed afterwards.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

patch.summary: Change a combination's label or activity. A deactivation strands the live reservations assigned to the combination. A write that would strand live reservations answers 409 (capacity_conflict, assignment_in_use) with their ids in `stranded` and writes nothing. With force the reservations are cancelled in the same transaction, with cancel_reason (default "venue change") and an outbox event each, and returned in `cancelled`; force answers 409 reservation_in_progress when one has started and 422 force_too_large above 200. A combination of another venue answers 404.

200.description: The combination and the ids of the reservations cancelled by force

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

get.summary: List the venue's service periods, inactive ones included, by day of week and opening time. Times are HH:MM in the venue's time zone. Requires the admin capability; a venue outside the key's venues answers 404.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Create a service period on an ISO weekday (1 Monday to 7 Sunday) from opens to closes, with the booking duration for each party size. closes_next_day is computed: a period closes the next day when closes is at or before opens. A shape the database refuses is 422 invalid_input.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

patch.summary: Change a service period; a field left out keeps its value, and closes_next_day is recomputed from the final times. A service period strands no reservation, so there is no force. A period of another venue answers 404.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

get.summary: List the venue's blackouts overlapping [from, to), inactive ones included, by start: a window of at most 400 days and at most 500 rows. from must be before to (400 validation); a window over 400 days is 422 invalid_input.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Create a blackout over [starts_at, ends_at), active unless active is false. An active blackout over live reservations answers 409 blackout_conflict with their ids in `stranded` and writes nothing. With force the reservations are cancelled in the same transaction, with cancel_reason (default "venue change") and an outbox event each, and returned in `cancelled`; force answers 409 reservation_in_progress when one has started and 422 force_too_large above 200. An inactive blackout is created without judgment.

201.description: The blackout and the ids of the reservations cancelled by force

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

patch.summary: Change a blackout's reason or activity; its range is fixed. Activating an inactive blackout is judged like creating an active one (409 blackout_conflict, or force with the same refusals); a change of reason and a deactivation strand nothing. A blackout of another venue answers 404.

200.description: The blackout and the ids of the reservations cancelled by force

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

get.summary: List the keys scoped to this venue alone, revoked ones included, oldest first. Keys of several venues or of all venues are not listed. A key's hash is never returned. Requires the admin capability; a venue outside the key's venues answers 404.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Create a key scoped to this venue alone, with 1 to 6 distinct capabilities (hold, confirm, cancel, seat, read, admin). The response carries the secret, which is shown once and cannot be retrieved later. A venue that does not exist answers 404.

201.description: The key and its secret, shown once

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues

post.summary: Revoke a key scoped to this venue alone; the key answers 401 from then on. Revoking again keeps the first revoked_at. A key may revoke itself. A key of another venue, of several venues, or of all venues answers 404.

404.description: Not found or outside the key's venues
